correctness.rationale: Reconstructed full exact statement for arbitrary finite groups G and nonempty subsets: T(G) fixes every subset outside layer n-1, including singleton units, and is C3 for C3, V4 for V4, trivial otherwise. For any n and nonempty A,B, |A|+|B|>n implies AB=G. For any n>=4 containing a of order>=3, A={1,a} and B=G\{g,a^-1g} both have interior sizes, and AB=G\{g}; for exponent-two elementary abelian groups n>=8, A={0,u,v}, B=G\A give AB=G\{0} by A∩(u+A)∩(v+A)={0}, and translation yields every co-singleton. In C3 and V4 no nonsingleton factors multiply to a co-singleton. Fixing singleton units forces induced missing-element map f(ag)=af(g) and f(ga)=f(g)a, hence f(g)=gz=zg for z central; all these shifts are multiplicative for C3/V4 because products of nonsingletons never yield a co-singleton. For V4 idempotent subsets are subgroups and left stabilizers/translation force all two-subsets fixed by a unit-fixed automorphism; the full group is V4⋊GL2(F2)=S4. C3 full group C3⋊C2=S3. Boundary n=1,2 checked. Recomputed source Git tree exactly from all 8 actual blob SHAs, matching f34fbd6f29b1afd89260d5f1d23a7f9c59b6fe23. Independent finite bitmask checker reproduced no interior co-singleton factorizations for C3/V4, all 4/5/6/8 for C4/C5/C6/E8, and checked all ordered set products for proposed 3 C3 and 4 V4 shifts; finite checks only corroborate universal symbolic proof.
residual_risks: Finite tests do not certify the arbitrary-group universal quantifier; analytic factorization and equivariance provide that proof.

originality.rationale: QUALIFIED best-of-knowledge PASS only for the universal all-finite-group top-layer-support classification, especially the nonabelian domain. Historical priority correction is major: Byrd–Lloyd–Pedersen–Stepp (1977) ALREADY prove the complete C3 unit-fixed kernel and AutF(C3)=S3; Byrd–Lloyd–Stepp (1979), citing 1978 work, ALREADY give the exact co-singleton-only V4 translation subgroup and full AutF(V4)=S4, and classify full automorphisms for all finite abelian groups. These exceptional examples and full small automorphism groups are NOT original and must not be represented as such. Their abelian theorem does NOT alone imply the nonabelian support classification: the assigned proof gives a uniform co-singleton interior factorization in every finite nonabelian group and thereby excludes top-only shifts. The 1978 locally-finite-group primary article was not accessible after lawful attempts; it may already imply the nonabelian remainder. Record this serious priority risk, not a fabricated noncoverage conclusion. Prior source omission prevents the existing package from being publication-ready without scientific attribution revision.
residual_risks: Major historical omission in RESULT.md and AUDIT.json: 1977/1979 already computed the exact small-group kernels, actions, and S3/S4. Scientific attribution needs a complete source-file correction before publication.
